scope: Offline causal audit of whether the frozen DOY240 aggregate reference receipt can support a total physical envelope for a later, still-unselected target. No source access, target selection, orbit access, new numerical observations or external correction products are allowed.
allowed_evidence: aggregate station metrics and admitted-grid hashes
forbidden_evidence_or_actions: target identity, target state or target orbit
external antenna, atmosphere, clock or orbit products
treating an unresolved contribution as zero
claiming population coverage from the DOY240 window

state_semantics.BOUNDED_BY_RECEIPT: The frozen receipt contains the coordinate and outcome-independent evidence needed to derive a numerical contribution in the future target coordinate.
state_semantics.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: The receipt contains evidence about the reference path but no justified transfer rule to the future target coordinate.
state_semantics.NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_FROM_RECEIPT: At least one causal quantity required for a future-target bound is absent and cannot be reconstructed from the aggregate receipt.
state_semantics.UNRESOLVED: The term remains physically possible and is not assigned zero or an arbitrary numerical bound.

terms.receipt_evidence: Receiver identities and aggregate reference residual limits for one selected window.
required_for_transfer: future target line-of-sight coordinates over the frozen window

terms.receipt_evidence: Aggregate reference residual limits from four reference directions per station over five minutes.
required_for_transfer: direction/time-resolved multipath bound or independently frozen site model
evidence that the bound covers the future target geometry
missing_from_receipt: future target direction and coverage rule

terms.receipt_evidence: Zero reported LLI in the selected reference window, aggregate phase-rate maxima/RMS and admitted-grid hashes.
required_for_transfer: frozen target-side slip detector with a quantified missed-slip limit
rule linking detector sensitivity to the inverse observable

terms.term: future atmosphere outside the selected reference rays
terms.receipt_evidence: Ionosphere-free dual-frequency combinations and a nominal neutral-delay model on the selected reference rays.
required_for_transfer: frozen neutral-atmosphere residual model with uncertainty
higher-order ionosphere and temporal/spatial decorrelation envelope

terms.term: broadcast-reference orbit and clock error transfer
terms.receipt_evidence: Target-excluded broadcast reference navigation hashes and aggregate residuals after an affine receiver-clock fit.
required_for_transfer: outcome-independent reference orbit/clock uncertainty with cross-satellite covariance
projection through the exact clock calibration and inverse model
missing_from_receipt: projection into a future target solution

terms.receipt_evidence: Reference-only aggregate residuals; target rows were removed before numerical parsing.
required_for_transfer: reference-target covariance propagated through calibration and prediction
target-side observable timing and transform convention

term_rule: A term is BOUNDED_BY_RECEIPT only if every required transfer quantity is present in the frozen aggregate receipt. Reference-path evidence without a transfer rule is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and the physical term remains NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_FROM_RECEIPT/UNRESOLVED.
composition_rule: Copy the two conditional reference-path envelopes without combining them. Form a total future-target envelope only if every listed term is BOUNDED_BY_RECEIPT in the applicable coordinate and all dependencies/correlations needed for composition are present.
stop_rule: Stop after the frozen receipt has been audited once. Do not select a target, authorize a primary, access a source or construct a numerical substitute for missing evidence.
